scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=packages/shared" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace=apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/web && npm run lint --workspace=apps/api
